pages.title: Foliot Farmer
pages.text: The farmer will harvest and re-plant crops in it's working area.$(br) If a deposit location is set it will collect the dropped items into the specified chest.$(br)

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: Use the book of calling to set the work area and deposit location of the farmer.$(br2) $(br) See Books of Calling for more information.$(br)

pages.title: Lazy Farmer?
pages.text: The spirit might pause for a few minutes after clearing his work area,$(br)   even if crops have mature since. This is a performance-saving$(br)   measure and not a bug, he will continue on his own.$(br2)  $()

pages.title: Lazy Farmer?
pages.text: $(br)  Set the work area again to make him continue work immediately.$(br)
